description: This file is a shell script that manages the setup and running of a rootless OpenClaw instance inside a Podman container. It includes functions for environment setup, token generation, configuration validation, and container launch commands, both for initial onboarding and for running the service as a background daemon.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves a user's home directory, using getent or /etc/passwd as fallback.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Checks that a given value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Ensures a given path is absolute, has no repeated slashes, and does not contain dot segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that a mount source path is absolute and not containing colon (':').

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Checks that a file exists, is regular, and not a symlink.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Checks that a directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Gets the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Gets the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures directory exists, owned by current user, with no group/write permissions for others.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures file exists, owned by current user, with owner-only permissions.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Prepares a writable path, ensuring safe write permissions and no symlinks.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Atomically writes content to a file with specified mode.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a Podman env file.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Validates that a port number is numeric and within range 1-65535.

methods.name: resolve_config_gateway_bind
methods.description: Resolves the gateway bind setting from the config or uses openclaw command.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Sets or updates an environment variable in a file.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a secure random 32-byte hex token, using available dependencies.

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates an env file containing a gateway token.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Synchronizes CORS origins configuration via CLI.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Synchronizes CORS origins configuration directly in a JSON config file.

methods.name: cleanup_token_env_file
methods.description: Removes temporary token env file on exit.
